name: 13-ps-extra-column
why: r6 item 2: the declared rule is 'any column-count mismatch is PROBE-UNKNOWN', but the old check only rejected rows shorter than the header, so a row with an extra trailing cell was accepted and WCHAN was read out of a cell the header never declared. The constructed fixture keeps the real 4-column header and gives the first thread 5 cells. Fixed behaviour: PROBE-UNKNOWN + UNKNOWN / exit 5, and the probe is never folded into NOT_FROZEN.
expectReport: ^PROBE-UNKNOWN .*reason=ps row 2 has 5 columns but the header has 4
